title: Recruiter Interviews on ATS Rejections
population: Recruiters, talent acquisition and HR professionals who use applicant tracking systems
method: Structured interviews covering the ATS systems each recruiter uses, match scores, knockout questions, automatic rejections, timing of applications and high-volume screening. Enhancv summarized each interviewee’s answers.
privacy: Enhancv removed names, LinkedIn profiles, employers, client names and cities, and generalized roles, industries, locations and company sizes.
